nodes.label: IMD weather

nodes.label: OpenAQ
nodes.rationale: connector_id openaq, provider OpenAQ, air quality, API key via AEROPULSE_OPENAQ_API_KEY sent as the X-API-Key header. Polls every 900 seconds. live_verified is false. Only pm25 and pm10 are ingested because gas sensors often report ppm and would corrupt the fused vector. Values older than AEROPULSE_CONNECTOR_MAX_OBSERVATION_AGE_HOURS are dropped. monitor=true limits discovery to reference-grade government monitors; in India those are CPCB CAAQMS, and other countries use the local equivalent. OpenAQ aggregates upstream networks, each with its own licence.

nodes.label: Open-Meteo
nodes.rationale: connector_id openmeteo, provider Open-Meteo, air quality and weather, anonymous public API, polls every 3600 seconds, live_verified true. Air quality values are CAMS-derived model output and are a background prior, never CPCB ground truth. aerosol_optical_depth is dimensionless and is never mapped to surface PM2.5. Non-commercial use is CC-BY-4.0; commercial deployment needs review. Attribution: Weather and air quality data by Open-Meteo.com.
